title: Verify an unattended run: stop condition and test gate
goal: Finish a script that runs an agent task with nobody watching. Add a stop condition, a test gate the script runs itself, a failure for no change or edited tests, evidence files for the morning review, and remove the auto-merge. Verify runs offline against fake agents and checks each outcome.
setup_cmd: D=~/fm-ex/ex-3-5-verify-unattended-run; if [ -e "$D" ]; then echo "Already set up at $D. Run: cd $D (or delete it first to start over)."; else mkdir -p ~/fm-ex && cp -r exercises/ex-3-5-verify-unattended-run/starter "$D" && cd "$D" && git init -q -b main && git add -A && git -c user.name=fm -c user.email=fm@example.com commit -qm baseline; fi

starter_prompts.claude: Read run-unattended.sh and tests/run-unattended.test.js. Edit only run-unattended.sh so that npm test passes. Requirements: kill the agent after MAX_SECONDS (exit 2, no use of the timeout command); exit 3 if the agent exits non-zero; exit 4 if nothing changed; exit 5 if a file under a PROTECTED prefix changed; run TEST_CMD yourself after the agent and exit 1 if it fails; write run.log, agent.log, tests.log, diff.stat, diff.patch and verdict to RUN_DIR before judging; remove the merge so the work stays committed on the agent branch and nothing is pushed or merged. Do not edit anything under tests/. Run npm test and report the result.
starter_prompts.codex: Read run-unattended.sh and tests/run-unattended.test.js. Edit only run-unattended.sh so that npm test passes. Requirements: kill the agent after MAX_SECONDS (exit 2, no use of the timeout command); exit 3 if the agent exits non-zero; exit 4 if nothing changed; exit 5 if a file under a PROTECTED prefix changed; run TEST_CMD yourself after the agent and exit 1 if it fails; write run.log, agent.log, tests.log, diff.stat, diff.patch and verdict to RUN_DIR before judging; remove the merge so the work stays committed on the agent branch and nothing is pushed or merged. Do not edit anything under tests/. Run npm test and report the result.

solution_notes: The script, not the agent, decides the verdict. It runs TEST_CMD itself and records TEST_EXIT, so a lying agent ("all tests pass, ready to merge") gets a FAIL.

Failure has to be visible: a timeout, a non-zero agent exit, an empty diff and an edited protected path each have their own exit code and a one-line reason in the verdict file. Editing the tests is checked separately because it is the cheapest way for an agent to turn the gate green without fixing anything.
The stop condition is a polling loop with kill, not the timeout command, because macOS has none. Job control gives the agent its own process group, so a stop also kills what the agent started.

Evidence is written before the run is judged, and the work is committed to an agent/<run> branch. A failed run can still be reviewed, and a passing one waits for a person: the script never merges, pushes or opens a PR.
The tests use fake agents and git and gh shims, so verify is free and offline, and it also proves nothing was merged or pushed.
